No other user performs a USDT transfer in the logs; 'liuyu' appears only in a login + /reports/q1-analysis.pdf download on 2024-03-05. The office-side log (file:/logs/app2.log) shows a 'chenwei' account performing upload/print activity from 10.20.0.5 and 10.20.0.9 on 2024-02-20/21. Whether the USDT-side 'chenwei' and the office-side 'chenwei' are the same person CANNOT be established from this evidence: README.txt (file:/README.txt) explicitly states the two internal systems 'share no account database', and there is no cross-system authentication artifact (no shared secret, session token, certificate, MFA record, or identity assertion) linking the two identities. The two systems also show disjoint IP ranges (public 203.0.113.x / 198.51.100.x on the USDT side vs. RFC1918 10.20.0.x on the office side), and the USDT log does not record a logout for the 2024-03-02 session, so session continuity is not verifiable. The evidence supports only an account-name match, which is a weak identifier and is explicitly non-identifying per the case README. Note also that the delegated scope is 'windows' but the image contains no Windows-derived artifacts (no registry, event logs, prefetch, amcache, or auth records) — only three plain-text files — so no execution/authentication corroboration is possible here.
